items.raw_excerpt: Learning how to whistle like a native is hard. Mexicans learn how to do it from childhood, as a part of their culture. Here's how to start.
items.summary_en: Whistling is a big part of Mexican culture. Many people learn it as children. This guide shows how anyone can start.

items.raw_excerpt: As an Italian cuisine lover, I was delighted to discover a family-run Italian restaurant in Alvor where recipes have been passed down through generations. And when I heard they have live music on Wednesdays, consisting mostly of Italian songs, there was nothing more to think about – we had to visit.
items.summary_en: A family-run Italian restaurant in Alvor makes food from recipes passed down through generations. On Wednesdays it hosts live music, mostly Italian songs. An Italian-food lover visited the place after hearing about this.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 알보르에 있는 가족이 운영하는 이탈리아 식당은 대를 이어 물려받은 요리법으로 음식을 만든다. 수요일에는 주로 이탈리아 노래로 이루어진 라이브 공연도 열린다. 이 소식을 들은 이탈리아 요리 애호가가 식당을 직접 찾아갔다.
items.title_en: Family-run Italian restaurant in Alvor serves old recipes and live music

items.raw_excerpt: Hundreds of homes across Wellington and the South Island are without power this morning.
items.summary_en: Hundreds of homes have no electricity this morning. The outage affects Wellington and parts of the South Island.

items.raw_excerpt: The Gauteng Dept of Roads handed over more than 550 licences to compliant scholar transport
items.summary_en: The Gauteng roads department has handed over more than 550 licences to approved school transport operators. These firms met all the safety rules set by the province. The goal is to keep children safe on the way to school.

items.raw_excerpt: Ação nacional incentiva atualização da caderneta e amplia proteção de crianças contra doenças infecciosas.
items.summary_en: Brazil held a special vaccination day across the country. Parents were asked to update their children's vaccine cards. Health officials also renewed warnings about measles.

items.raw_excerpt: The early social media phenomenon around Aziz Shavershian may seem like a precursor to some of the uglier corners of the internet, but the late bodybuilder's brother says they preach a different message.
items.summary_en: A new documentary looks at Aziz Shavershian, known online as Zyzz. He was an Australian bodybuilder who became a social media star. His brother says they now share a kinder message than some harsh parts of the internet.
items.summary_ko: 새 다큐멘터리가 온라인에서 유명해진 호주 보디빌더 아지즈 샤버시안을 다룬다. 그의 동생은 지금은 인터넷의 거친 문화와 달리 더 따뜻한 메시지를 전하고 있다고 말했다.
items.title_en: New documentary revisits Zyzz, the famous online bodybuilder

items.raw_excerpt: El jugador además aseguró que pidió jugar el Superclásico antes de irse, pero el trato entre clubes se lo impidió.
items.summary_en: Young footballer Assadi is leaving Universidad de Chile for a move to Sweden. He gave a farewell message during his trip. He also said he asked to play in the big derby match before leaving, but the agreement between the two clubs did not allow it.

items.title_original: Assadi se despidió en su viaje a Suecia: Voy a dejar bien puesto el nombre de la U afuera

items.raw_excerpt: Japans Crown Prince Akishino and Crown Princess Kiko lay flowers at a Japanese immigration memorial in La Colmena, Paraguay, on Saturday, as part of a six-day goodwill tour commemorating the 90th anniversary of Japanese immigration to Paraguay.
items.summary_en: Japan's Crown Prince Akishino and Crown Princess Kiko laid flowers at a Japanese immigration memorial in La Colmena, Paraguay. The visit marks 90 years since Japanese people first moved to Paraguay.

items.raw_excerpt: When Aor visited the Din Daeng district office sometime in June, a registration officer questioned her about the number of Myanmar children listed on her family's household registration.
items.summary_en: A woman in Bangkok cares for many Myanmar children in one small flat. A district office asked her why so many children were on her family registration paper.

items.summary_en: The Canadian club CF Montreal faced the famous American team LA Galaxy at home in Major League Soccer. Chilean star Alexis Sanchez and coach Gillier lead the Montreal team.

items.raw_excerpt: No centro dessa história está um peixe que, até então, não era valorizado comercialmente por pescadores e pescadoras: a ubarana.
items.summary_en: The ubarana is a small fish that fishers in Rio de Janeiro did not value before. Now it is sold and brings good money. Women who fish there say it has improved their income.
items.summary_ko: 우바라나라는 작은 생선은 예전에 리우데자네이루 어민들이 상업적 가치를 두지 않았습니다. 이제 이 생선을 팔면서 좋은 수입을 얻습니다. 그곳에서 어업을 하는 여성들은 이 생선 덕분에 수입이 늘었다고 말합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Female teachers are speaking out about how the "manosphere" is affecting classrooms, with some saying they have noticed a rise in misogynistic attitudes among students.
items.summary_en: Female teachers in Australia are speaking out about the 'manosphere' online world. They say more students now show hateful attitudes toward women. Some teachers have seen Nazi salutes and cruel jokes in class.
items.summary_ko: 호주의 여교사들이 온라인 '마노스피어' 문화에 대해 공개적으로 말하고 나섰다. 학생들 사이에서 여성을 향한 혐오 태도가 늘었다고 지적한다. 일부 교사는 교실에서 나치식 경례와 모욕적인 농담까지 목격했다고 한다.
items.title_en: Teachers speak out as the 'manosphere' enters classrooms

items.raw_excerpt: Real Madrid logró un triunfo agónico 2-1 ante Espanyol en el RCDE Stadium en su debut en una nueva temporada de La Liga. Los goles del encuentro fueron anotados por Jude Bellingham y Carlos Espí para los "merengues", mientras que Alex Calatrava anotó para los locales.
items.summary_en: Real Madrid beat Espanyol 2-1 at the RCDE Stadium. It was their first game of the new La Liga season. Jude Bellingham and Carlos Espi scored for Real Madrid, while Alex Calatrava scored for Espanyol.

items.title_en: Real Madrid wins 2-1 against Espanyol

items.title_original: Real Madrid logró un triunfo agónico ante Espanyol en su debut en La Liga 26/27

items.raw_excerpt: A associação diz que os valores registados são "muito mais do dobro do permitido" e promete enviar os dados à câmara, à CCDR e à Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente.
items.summary_en: People living near a factory in Alentejo, Portugal, bought their own equipment to measure air pollution. They were tired of waiting for official tests. The group says the levels are more than double the allowed limit and will send the data to local authorities.

items.title_en: Tired of waiting, villagers buy their own tools to check factory air

items.raw_excerpt: Step back in time with Cornwall Museum and Art Gallery's 'I Grew Up 80s' exhibition
items.summary_en: Cornwall Museum and Art Gallery has a new exhibition called 'I Grew Up 80s'. It celebrates life in the 1980s with neon colors and warm memories.

items.raw_excerpt: This charming Ontario village looks like something that was plucked from a Hallmark film. With colourful storefronts, sandy beaches, sparkling blue water and historic streets, it's an enchanting spot for a day trip or weekend escape.
items.summary_en: Bayfield is a small village in Ontario, Canada, next to Lake Huron. It has colorful shops, sandy beaches, and historic streets. The village is a nice place for a day trip or a short weekend trip.

items.raw_excerpt: Anugerah Murni Sabta and Aqid Aiman Azmi run Sendok Rakyat through workshops, walks and gatherings. They encourage participants to experience food heritage through shared stories and everyday cooking.
items.summary_en: Anugerah Murni Sabta and Aqid Aiman Azmi run Sendok Rakyat in Singapore. They hold workshops, walks and gatherings about local food heritage. They invite people to share stories and cook everyday food together.
items.summary_ko: 아누그라 무르니 삽타와 아키드 아이만 아즈미 부부는 'Sendok Rakyat'를 운영하며 워크숍, 산책, 모임을 열고 있다. 참가자들은 함께 이야기를 나누고 평범한 요리를 하며 싱가포르의 음식유산을 체험한다. 두 사람은 음식유산을 매일의 삶 속으로 들여오고 있다.
